Medical practices

ClinicOS

Patients, appointments and prescriptions — without the paperwork.

A practice management system for private clinics and specialists: patient records, a live waiting-room queue, printed prescriptions and automatic WhatsApp appointment reminders.

Request a demoDescribe your project

The problem

Many practices still run on paper files and a phone diary. Finding a patient's history takes time, prescriptions are handwritten, and missed appointments leave gaps in the day.

What we built

ClinicOS connects reception and the consultation room. The secretary books and checks patients in; the doctor sees the queue and the full patient file, writes the prescription from a drug list and prints it on the practice letterhead. Patients get a WhatsApp reminder before their visit.

Key modules

  • 01

    Patient records

    History, allergies, chronic conditions, past visits and documents.

  • 02

    Appointments

    Daily and weekly agenda for one or several doctors.

  • 03

    Waiting room

    A live queue shared between reception and the consultation room.

  • 04

    Prescriptions

    Drug list with dosage suggestions, printed on your letterhead.

  • 05

    WhatsApp reminders

    Patients are reminded automatically before their appointment.

  • 06

    Payments & reports

    Consultation fees, daily takings and activity reports.

Platforms
Windows desktop (works offline) · Web dashboard · Android
